hero.description: Choose the latest trends from your own closet. Our AI stylist analyzes your wardrobe and creates perfect outfits for every occasion.

step1.title: Upload Your Closet
step1.description: Add photos of your clothes, shoes, and accessories. Organize by category, color, and season.

step2.title: Describe Your Look
step2.description: Tell our AI what you need: casual dinner? Professional meeting? The AI understands context.

step3.title: See It On You
step3.description: See each outfit on a photo of you before deciding.

why.description: We combine artificial intelligence with personal styling to help you make the most of what you already own.

features.tryon_live: Try it on with a photo

preview.arHint: Upload your photo once and see every look on you

locked.description: The AI stylist needs to generate 3 outfit options before you can try them on.

tryon.uploadHint: Upload a full-body photo of yourself, facing the camera and well lit. We will use it to show you in each outfit.
tryon.privacy: Your photo is stored privately and sent to Google Gemini to generate the images. You can delete it at any time; generated looks are deleted one by one from My looks.
tryon.generate: See how it looks on me
tryon.generatingHint: This can take up to a minute.
tryon.aiNotice: AI-generated image: the real fit may differ.
tryon.photoError: Generate the look first to save it
tryon.outdatedNotice: This look was generated from an earlier photo.
tryon.noPhotoNotice: Generated from a photo that is gone. Upload a photo to generate new looks.

regenerate.title: Generate another version?
regenerate.description: A new image of this look will replace the current one; the previous one cannot be recovered. Each generation has a cost and counts toward your daily limit.

refresh.title: Update this look with your current photo?
refresh.description: It will be generated again from your current photo and replace the image you see, made from an earlier photo. Each generation has a cost and counts toward your daily limit.

change.title: Change your base photo?
change.description: The new photo will be used for the looks you generate from now on. The looks you already have stay as they are; you can update each one with your new photo whenever you want.

delete.title: Delete your base photo?
delete.description: Your photo will be deleted. The looks you already generated are kept, but you will not be able to generate or update looks until you upload another photo.

consent.title: Before you upload your photo
consent.intro: To keep everyone safe, your photo must meet these conditions:
consent.itself: It is you in the photo, and you are alone.
consent.clothed: You are wearing clothes: no nudity and nothing sexual, violent or illegal.
consent.review: We review it automatically with AI before saving it; if it does not meet the conditions, it is not saved. It is then sent to Google Gemini to generate your looks.
consent.confirm: I confirm my photo meets these conditions
